specVersion.description: Adapter format version. Apps skip a remote adapter whose version is newer than they support.

minAppBuild.description: Lowest app build (CFBundleVersion) that can run this adapter. Set only when the engine had to change.

geocoderNames.description: Names a reverse geocoder gives for the municipality, e.g. ["Värmdö", "Värmdö kommun"]; a pin in the bounding box but in another municipality is outside.

baseURL.description: Plain https origin: no user, port, path or query. A downloaded adapter must keep the bundled adapter's host, kind and service.

completionPostBackMarker.description: Text on the page shown after Slutför that means the browser would now auto-post the form (e.g. Abou's ThankYou page runs __doPostBack('', '') on load to finish processing). While present, Fixa re-posts the form with an empty __EVENTTARGET.

pages.description: Pages in order; the last one is the summary page whose Next submits the case.

role.description: fullName: first and last name joined with a space, for forms with one name field. answer: the draft's answer to `question` (tile answers win); a text/textarea gets the first value, a select or radio the matching option (exact value, visible text, synonyms), a checkbox list one ticked box per value. Nothing is posted for an empty answer.

question.description: Role answer: id of the question in `questions` this field sends. Several fields may send the same question (e.g. one per conditional block).

type.description: HTML control type; a renamed control of the same type may be used when its label matches

labels.description: Question texts per language, e.g. {"sv": ["Beskriv felet här"]}; matched case-, diacritic- and '*'-insensitively when the key is not on the page

optionSynonyms.description: Other values or visible texts for a radio option, keyed by yesValue/noValue

upload.description: The single photo upload of adapters written before `uploads`; still read. Prefer `uploads`.

uploads.description: Photo uploads. Each applies on its page when its `when` holds (none: always); the photo goes with the first that applies.

synonyms.description: Other option values or visible texts meaning this category, tried after the value and its visible text

swedishSummary.description: First line of the description sent to the municipality. Omit when the category says it all; then the resident's own text must reach validation.descriptionMin by itself.

responsibility.description: Short note under the tile on who looks after this problem (e.g. municipal streets vs state or private roads). Omit when the municipality always handles it.

links.description: The municipality's other e-services for things that don't belong here, opened in Safari. https only, on the municipality's own domain.

adapterID.description: A bundled adapter (e.g. se.varmdo.felater) whose form this link opens in Fixa; builds that don't know it open `url`.

answers.description: Answers this tile fixes, by question id, e.g. {"action": ["Städning"]}. Never asked in the app; choice values must be options of the question.

questionIDs.description: Questions asked for this tile, in order. Absent: every question not fixed by `answers`.

photoRequired.description: The form refuses a report without a photo.

emailRequired.description: The form needs an e-mail address whether or not a reply is wanted (only with an email field).

descriptionRequired.description: False when the description field may stay empty (an "Övrig information" box): no minimum then, the maximum still applies. Default true.

service.description: Present on every adapter listed under Home's "More forms". Absent on the municipality's main fault-report adapter, whose tiles fill Home's grid (that one must have category and description fields).

title.description: The e-service's name for residents; needs sv and en.

subtitle.description: One short line: what the form is for.

order.description: Ascending order on Home; absent sorts last, then by id.

questions.description: Questions the resident answers in Fixa's own controls. Every question is sent by at least one answer field; ids are unique.

kind.description: Answers are stored as a list: the typed text, the chosen option value, every ticked value, or an ISO 8601 date-time with offset (sent as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm Stockholm time, never more than 5 minutes ahead).

title.description: The question; its sv text heads the answer line in the filed text.

options.description: choice, multiChoice: non-empty, unique values; value is the exact form option.

suggestions.description: text: tap-to-fill chips; the Swedish value becomes the answer.

maxLength.description: text, longText: longest answer the form takes.

translate.description: text, longText: an answer typed in another language goes as "<Swedish machine translation> (<original>)", or as typed past maxLength. Leave unset for codes and names (number plates, makes, addresses).

descriptionTitle.description: Heading of the description box when the form's description means something narrower ("Where is it growing?"). Absent: Fixa's own wording.

placeQuestion.description: Forms without a place field: id of the question whose answer says where the report is for (a station, an address). Shown in Sent reports and used by the repeat-report check.

items.description: Applies on the weekdays from 'from' (default 00:00) until before 'until', local time.

holidays.description: Public-holiday calendar on which no rule applies, so defaultContactID answers. SE: Swedish public holidays plus julafton, nyårsafton and midsommarafton.

infoURL.description: The municipality's own page about water and sewer, shown as 'More about water and sewer' under the water call card. An https page on the municipality's domain; opened in the in-app Safari view when its host is in allowedWebHosts.

webFormURL.description: The municipality's own web form for this e-service, on the channel's host. Fixa opens it when it cannot send. A downloaded adapter must keep the bundled value.

contact.description: Where residents ask the municipality anything, including about a report they sent. Fixa copies the case number and opens this page; it never calls or e-mails the municipality for this.

pageURL.description: The municipality's contact page (e.g. its contact centre). An https page on the municipality's domain.

title.description: The page's name, e.g. 'Värmdö kommuns kontaktcenter'.

allowedWebHosts.description: Hosts on the municipality's domain whose https pages open in the in-app Safari view (exact host match). Every other link opens in Safari. Absent: every link opens in Safari.

path.description: Path on baseURL's host: starts with one '/', no scheme, '//', ':', backslash or whitespace.

localizedText.description: Language code to text; resolves to the user's language, then en, then sv.

value.description: Exact option value (choices) or Swedish text (suggestions) sent to the form.

location.description: choice options only: where the place (a recycling station) is, WGS84, inside municipality.region.bbox. The app offers the nearest option and lists them by distance; never sent to the form.

upload.description: kind ajax (default): the platform's FileUploadField2, posted to `path` before the page and checked at `actionPath`; needs fieldID, path, actionPath, filePartName, fileName. kind formFile: an <input type="file"> named by key/control, sent in the page's own multipart/form-data POST (every form field, every file input as an empty part, the photo in this one). A page whose <form> has enctype="multipart/form-data" is always posted as multipart.

pageID.description: A page id: the page the upload precedes (ajax) or travels with (formFile).

fieldID.description: ajax: field id with dots, e.g. FELATER.7

key.description: formFile: field key of the file input, e.g. invasivaarter_8

control.description: formFile: control of the file input, e.g. fileUploadControl

when.description: Upload only when the draft's answer to `question` (tile answers win) contains `value`.
